# IBenjiArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/arks/IBenjiArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IArkWithSwap](../i-ark-with-swap.md), [IBenjiArkErrors](../../errors/arks/i-benji-ark-errors.md), [IBenjiArkEvents](../../events/arks/i-benji-ark-events.md)

**Title:**
IBenjiArk

Interface for `BenjiArk` — the Franklin Templeton iBENJI Ark.

Extends `IArkWithSwap` (which extends `IArk`) because the Ark's escape hatch is the
curator-whitelisted router swap; the SwapPool entry/exit itself is synchronous, so there is
no `IArkWithWithdrawalRequest` surface.


## Functions
### sharesToAssets

Converts an iBENJI share amount to the equivalent base-asset amount at 1:1 par.


```solidity
function sharesToAssets(uint256 shares) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|Amount in `shareDecimals`|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|assets Equivalent amount in `assetDecimals`|


### isArkOnboarded

Whether this Ark is an authorized trader for the asset/iBENJI pair on the given
SwapPool and may therefore swap through it. Trader authorization is granted
off-chain by Franklin Templeton per pool.


```solidity
function isArkOnboarded(address swapPool) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`swapPool`|`address`|The SwapPool to check|


### whitelistedSwapPools

Whether the given SwapPool is approved by the curator for board/disembark.


```solidity
function whitelistedSwapPools(address swapPool) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`swapPool`|`address`|The SwapPool to check|


### whitelistSwapPool

Adds or removes a SwapPool from the curator whitelist. The keeper selects one of the
whitelisted pools per rebalance via `boardData`/`disembarkData`
(`abi.encode(address pool)`).


```solidity
function whitelistSwapPool(address swapPool, bool isWhitelisted) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`swapPool`|`address`|The SwapPool address|
|`isWhitelisted`|`bool`|The new whitelist status|
